hook: You can now video chat with 2 Meta models.

sections.voiceover: You can now video chat with 2 Meta models.
sections.visual_cue: Close-up of two distinct, expressive digital avatars appearing on a smartphone display.

sections.voiceover: Meta introduced Muse in September 2026. Where did it launch November 5, 2026?
sections.visual_cue: Graphic displaying September 2026 conference graphics alongside a digital calendar icon for November 5, 2026.

sections.voiceover: But Muse Voice handles tasks in the background.
sections.visual_cue: Animation showing a user walking outdoors while audio waveform icons pulse on screen.

sections.voiceover: Meta launched in 1 country, the United States. It brings real-time spoken conversations across 3 platform types: mobile, web, and Mac.
sections.visual_cue: Graphic displaying 3 platform icons next to a map highlight of the United States.

sections.voiceover: Check all 3 platforms for background voice interaction.
sections.visual_cue: Interface layout displaying active app windows across mobile, web, and Mac.
